scripts.build:release: pnpm --filter @connexto/frontend build && node scripts/sync-frontend-dist.mjs && go build -o bin/ai-hub ./cmd/ai-hub/
scripts.check: go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1 -race && pnpm --filter @connexto/frontend check
